memory.description:
Memory resource request and limit in the form of 10Mb-80Mb.
If a single value of 80Mb is specified, it expands to 80Mb-80Mb.

javaMemory.description:
Java Heap size in the form of 7m-70m,
in case the Task Node is a Java process.
It's translated into -Xms7m -Xmx70m.
If a single value of 70m is specified, it expands to -Xms70m -Xmx70m.

cpu.description:
Cpu resource request and limit in the form of 0.3-1.
If a single value of 1 is specified, it expands to 1-1.

taskRecycleCount.description: How many times a TaskNode can accept actions before it shuts down.

title: This type determines the resource requirements of a Task Node.
name: Env.Task.Group
